visualPolicy.editorial: All real editorial content requires explicit human approval before publication.

typography.accent: Fraunces italic — max one emphasized phrase per screen

layout.visualPriority: entire screen, no rounded rectangle information stacks
layout.headlinePosition: lower two-thirds; can vary by topic
layout.textLimit: one key thought per scene, up to one concise supporting sentence

motion.reducedMotion: no animation and no smooth scrolling; all text and source information persist
motion.accessibility: animate visual decoration only; never scramble number glyphs or simulate changing amounts

assets.semantic: opening photo-like textile folds and thread contours
thematic texture behind comparative figures, geometry not a chart
open-ended flowing textile trajectories, not a causal diagram

technicalHandoff.use: full-bleed scene background layer, behind DOM copy and verified DataCardView
technicalHandoff.not: do not insert 1080x1920 SVG in the existing 14rem visual slot
technicalHandoff.required: copy remains DOM, figures from typed data-cards, sources from approved publications
technicalHandoff.status: not added to public/media/visuels because approval has not been recorded
